Live CPU and memory moved out of the overview strip and into a footer bar, so
the readings stay visible on every screen — including a container's detail page.
The overview is back to three cards: Containers, Images and Volumes.

The footer shows host CPU share and total memory used by running containers, and
says plainly whether the stats are still connecting, the host is disconnected, no
container is running, or only some containers are reporting yet.

Install:

    brew install adgan/tap/contui

Upgrading from 0.3.0:

    brew update && brew upgrade contui

The bottle is arm64 macOS 26 (Tahoe) only. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized: the first launch
may need right-click → Open.
